description: Dependency-ordered thin vertical journeys for anonymous-first free utility hub. No legacy email/subscription slices.

slices.name: IA Cleanup and Route Normalization
slices.description: Resolve dead /tools directory, fix 404 homepage routes, remove exposed pricing/subscription pages from nav/sitemap, normalize legacy /calculators paths. Prerequisite before any routes are exposed.
slices.verticalSpan: Dead content removal → 404 fix → retired route cleanup → canonical /tools establishment → mobile overflow fix
slices.testApproach: Deployed URL verification, 404 audit, nav/sitemap audit, mobile overflow check
slices.note: Must complete before any other route is exposed. No legacy email/subscription slices.

slices.name: Homepage Visual Module Distribution
slices.description: Build homepage with 2,000+ words distributed through visual modules: hero → tool discovery/value cards → workflow/timeline → UI/proof panels → use-case modules → safety/trust boundary → FAQ → CTA.
slices.verticalSpan: IA cleanup complete → homepage visual modules → 2,000+ words → CTA to /tools
slices.testApproach: Deployed URL verification, word count verification, visual module audit, mobile responsive check
slices.note: No text walls. All modules must be visual and scannable. No pricing/subscription CTA.

slices.name: Tool Catalogue Constrained Layout
slices.description: Build /tools as a constrained desktop tool catalogue showing every actual tool with status, input→output promise, and direct action. Mobile stacks with no horizontal overflow.
slices.verticalSpan: Tool catalogue → desktop constrained layout → mobile stack → no horizontal overflow
slices.testApproach: Deployed URL verification, desktop/mobile responsive check, tool reachability check
slices.note: One canonical /tools/<tool-slug> per shipped tool. No fake tool routes.

slices.name: Batch Cost Calculator — First Proof
slices.description: Build the genuinely working batch cost calculator as the first proof vertical. Source audit confirms working implementation with tests. User enters inputs → sees complete deterministic result → local save/export/share → reload/re-entry.
slices.verticalSpan: Tool catalogue → batch cost tool → complete visible result → local save/export/share → reload/re-entry preserves context
slices.testApproach: Unit tests from existing batch-cost.test.ts, E2E anonymous flow, calculation test suite, reload/re-entry test
slices.note: FIRST PROOF vertical. Non-chemistry tool. No safety gate. Must demonstrate visible result, local save/export/context handoff, and reload/re-entry.

slices.name: Recipe Scaling Calculator
slices.description: Build recipe scaling as the second vertical journey. Context transfers from scaling to batch cost.
slices.verticalSpan: Tool catalogue → recipe scaling → complete result → context handoff to batch cost
slices.testApproach: Unit tests, context transfer test, reload test
slices.note: Second vertical journey. Context transfer to batch cost demonstrated.

slices.name: Additional Non-Chemistry Tools
slices.description: Add mold-volume and craft-fair-break-even tools from source audit.
slices.verticalSpan: Tool catalogue → additional tools → complete results → context handoff
slices.note: Each tool must show status, input→output promise, and direct action.

slices.name: Public Support Pages
slices.description: Build methodology, safety, privacy, and terms pages as public support routes.
slices.verticalSpan: Public support pages → methodology, safety, privacy, terms → all publicly accessible
slices.testApproach: Deployed URL verification, public access test
slices.note: All support routes must be public and accessible. No auth gates.

slices.name: SEO Infrastructure Update
slices.description: Update robots.txt, sitemap, and metadata for canonical public routes only. Remove retired routes from sitemap.
slices.verticalSpan: Robots/sitemap update → retired route exclusion → canonical URL fix → public page verification
slices.testApproach: Deployed URL verification, sitemap audit, robots.txt audit
slices.note: Retired routes (/pricing, /subscription, /marketing/*, /calculators/*) must be excluded from sitemap and robots.

slices.name: Blog Draft Content
slices.description: Prepare /blog as unlaunched/draft content only. Not acquisition scope; no thin SEO expansion.
slices.verticalSpan: Blog as draft content only → not acquisition scope → no thin SEO expansion
slices.testApproach: Deployed URL verification, draft status confirmation
slices.note: /blog is draft content only. Not part of acquisition scope. No thin SEO expansion.

slices.name: Chemistry Verification Gate
slices.description: Complete the chemistry verification gate: deterministic specification, source manifest, independent review, hand/reference calculations, cross-calculator fixtures. Required before any chemistry feature becomes public.
slices.verticalSpan: Deterministic spec → source manifest → independent review → fixtures → public release gate
slices.testApproach: Independent fixture verification, domain owner review sign-off, cross-calculator comparison
slices.note: GATED. Chemistry is never first proof. No real formulation output is advertised as usable or considered released until verification passes.

Gate_C.description: Stop implementation until IA cleanup complete and every core flow has a high-boundary acceptance row
Gate_C.note: Isaac authorized implementation on 2026-09-09. IA cleanup must complete before routes are exposed.

Gate_R.description: No slice starts when a required skill is missing, unloadable, unapplied, or unreceipted
Gate_R.note: All skills routed and receipted. See skill-receipts.json.

Gate_A.description: Only literal RELEASE_ACCEPTED permits completion claim
Gate_A.note: Awaiting RELEASE_ACCEPTED after build and verification. Chemistry features are gated until verification gate passes.

note: No legacy email/subscription slices. No pricing/subscription/marketing slices. All slices are dependency-ordered thin vertical journeys based on user-visible, dependency-ready journeys.
